message.content: {"hts_code": "7326.20.0080", "reason": "The iron sign bracket is an article of iron or steel not elsewhere specified (wrought/forged-type fabricated articles of iron or steel under heading 7326), and as a non-specified article of iron or steel it falls under 7326.20 (of iron or steel wire) or 7326.90 (other), with 7326.20.0080 being the applicable residual subheading for other articles of iron or steel wire-form and fabricated items, though the more precise classification under 7326.90.8688 may apply depending on the fabrication method."}

predicted_reason: The iron sign bracket is an article of iron or steel not elsewhere specified (wrought/forged-type fabricated articles of iron or steel under heading 7326), and as a non-specified article of iron or steel it falls under 7326.20 (of iron or steel wire) or 7326.90 (other), with 7326.20.0080 being the applicable residual subheading for other articles of iron or steel wire-form and fabricated items, though the more precise classification under 7326.90.8688 may apply depending on the fabrication method.
